packageRules.description: Own images use the reused :main tag and are rolled out with `kubectl rollout restart`; nothing to bump.
Pin third-party images by digest so floating tags (:latest, :java25, :2-alpine) only change through a PR.
Digest refreshes and patch bumps for workload apps: ArgoCD deploys them on merge, so let them merge themselves.
One weekly PR for the media stack instead of five.
Platform layer (CNI, cert-manager, ArgoCD itself...) is deployed by ArgoCD the moment it merges, so never let it merge itself.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Platform change: `setup-homelab/` is synced by ArgoCD's `platform` ApplicationSet on merge (except `tailscale/`, which is applied by hand). `infra/` changes need `tofu plan`/`apply`. Read the upstream upgrade notes first.

packageRules.description: Major bumps always wait for a human, and only after being ticked on the dependency dashboard.
